tests.title: Sending a message shows it optimistically
tests.expectedResult: The message appears in the thread immediately, with a pending clock icon until the server confirms it.

tests.title: Emoji reaction syncs across devices
tests.expectedResult: The reaction and its count are identical on both devices.

tests.title: Wrong password is rejected
tests.expectedResult: An error appears under the password field; the user stays on the sign-in screen.

templates.name: Monthly regression — fresh install
templates.description: Two phones, clean install, QA account.

flows.name: Sign in
flows.precondition: Relay installed, signed out. You have the qa-1 credentials.

steps.text: Open Relay and tap Sign in.
Enter qa-1 with a wrong password and submit.

steps.expectedResult: An error is shown and you are still on the sign-in screen.

steps.text: Enter the correct password and submit.

flows.name: Messaging across two devices
flows.precondition: Relay installed on both phones, signed in as qa-1 on Device A and qa-2 on Device B.

steps.text: On Device A, open the chat with qa-2.
Watch the thread as the message is sent.
steps.expectedResult: It appears immediately, with a pending clock icon.

steps.text: Pick up Device B and open the same chat.
Compare the reaction on both screens.
steps.expectedResult: Same emoji, same count, on both.
